decisive_items: auto-agglutination with macro-aggregates of red cells up to 100 μm in length and rouleaux
response.rationale: The patient's laboratory results, including auto-agglutination and elevated D-dimer, are more consistent with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) than with other options.

rejected.why: Procoagulant and vasculitic studies were negative, contradicting antiphospholipid syndrome.
Elevated tumor markers are not specific to cancer-associated thrombosis.
Negative vasculitic studies contradict cerebral vasculitis.
